title: TEMA shell-and-tube exchanger type designation and selected TEMA tables (as tabulated by the ht package)
provenance: ht 1.2.0 (PyPI sdist ht-1.2.0.tar.gz, sha256 ae117387c4e99a1860d78afd391d24b1a4217cb7495250cd480606e2b7fa2ff5, MIT, C. Bell), ht/hx.py (sha256 ec3d6a9d296328b2754efe250a3019d3ccba03efc04bf613e730a52720d7ca5c), which cites TEMA Standards 9th ed. 2007; designation letters cross-checked with Wikipedia 'Tubular Exchanger Manufacturers Association' and wermac / heat-exchanger-world extracts [S28]

designation.rule: three letters: front (stationary) head, shell, rear head; e.g. BEM = bonnet, one-pass shell, fixed tubesheet like B; AES = removable channel and cover, one-pass shell, floating head with backing device; AEU = U-tube bundle

frontHeads.N: Channel Integral With Tubesheet and Removable Cover

rearHeads.L: Fixed Tube Sheet; Like "A" Stationary Head
rearHeads.M: Fixed Tube Sheet; Like "B" Stationary Head
rearHeads.N: Fixed Tube Sheet; Like "C" Stationary Head

designation.fixedTubesheetRule: rear head L, M or N = fixed tubesheet (bundle not removable); P, S, T, W = floating head; U = U-tube (removable bundle) [S27, S28]

tubeSizes.note: TEMA standard tube OD (in) and BWG gauges; wall thickness from the BWG table (ht quotes engineeringpage.com). Grade B: one secondary tabulation.

shellBundleClearance.note: recommended diametral shell-to-bundle clearance by shell ID (ht shell_clearance, TEMA 9th ed.); V1 bundle sizing only

maxUnsupportedTubeSpan.note: TEMA maximum unsupported straight tube span (ht L_unsupported_max, TEMA 9th ed. p 5.4-5); tube OD in, span m. The ht table lists 0.628 in where 0.625 (5/8 in) is meant - transcribed as 0.625 here. V1 check EQP_TUBE_SPAN_EXCEEDED.

tubeCountReference.note: tube counts for a bundle (V1 tubesheet layout); expected values from ht tests (reference code), methods Phadke (exact count), HEDH, VDI, Perry
tubeCountReference.grade: A (reference-code values; the Phadke 45 deg cases are stated in ht as published examples)
